# LuckPerms

LuckPerms is a permissions plugin for Minecraft servers. It lets server admins control what players can do with groups, tracks, and permission nodes.

- Site: https://luckperms.net/
- Download: https://luckperms.net/download
- Wiki: https://luckperms.net/wiki
- Getting started: https://luckperms.net/wiki/getting-started
- Web editor: https://luckperms.net/editor
- Verbose viewer: https://luckperms.net/verbose
- Tree viewer: https://luckperms.net/treeview
- GitHub: https://github.com/LuckPerms/LuckPerms
- Discord: https://discord.gg/luckperms
